_comment: Mutations that put the review-panel findings BACK into the branch.
The review panel on 891aeb5 returned HOLD: 4 of the 4 engines that
answered said YES. Every finding below was MEASURED in the code by the
parent before it was treated as real.
FINDING 1 (opencode, claude): the image is built from the Docker build
CONTEXT (`COPY . .`) while the AGPL-3.0 section 13 offer publishes the
COMMITTED tree. `git status --porcelain` -- what the deploy stamp uses to
refuse a dirty checkout -- does NOT list ignored files, so a file git
ignores was invisible to the stamp and still copied into the image.
Measured before the fix: 30 of the 46 positive .gitignore patterns had no
covering .dockerignore pattern, and 48 of the 451 git-ignored files
present in the tree would have been copied in -- including the review
panel's own transcripts and the full review.diff. The credential-copy
class was the sharp end of it: .gitignore closes .env, .env.*, .env_*
and .env-* (dot, underscore AND hyphen), while .dockerignore had only
the first two, so a .env_backup would have been baked into an image
layer.
FINDING 2 (dsh): the deploy gate and the smoke test both decided 'is the
source offer live?' with `curl -sk`. Skipping certificate verification
means neither check can tell the real offer from one served through an
impersonated certificate. The live certificate was measured directly: a
valid Let's Encrypt certificate for depthsight.diverseinc.net, notAfter
2027-01-12, TLS 1.3, verification SUCCEEDS -- so the -k was never
needed. The ops sidecar needed a CA bundle to verify at all, so
ca-certificates is now installed explicitly in ops/Dockerfile.
Every needle below occurs EXACTLY ONCE in its target file (asserted
before use by tests/test_deployed_commit_mutation_needles.py, which
covers both deployed-commit specs and every mutation in them).
Run with:  python tools/mutation_harness.py tools/mutations/source_offer_image_and_certificate.json
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or a reviewer -- both will read a
file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.

mutations.label: M1: the credential-copy class loses its underscore separator, so a .env_backup enters the image
M2: the review panel's transcripts and review.diff are no longer excluded from the image
M3: the smoke test skips certificate verification again, so it cannot tell the real offer from an impersonated one
M4: the deploy gate's certificate check never fires, so a broken certificate is reported as a missing offer
M5: the ops sidecar loses its CA bundle, so the smoke test cannot verify a certificate even if it tries to
